answer: Agents register through a TPM/SGX enclave that emits zero-knowledge attestation of measured code and a hardware-bound key; the gale state tree commits identities, oasis consensus contract verifies proofs, and violet verification circuit checks freshness. Forging one identity requires compromising the enclave or physically provisioning distinct silicon. A quadratic bonding curve imposes O(N^2) capital, with failed proofs irreversibly slashed.
